name: ez
description: Route Codex tasks to a cost-appropriate model and reasoning level before completing them.

interface.longDescription: ez selects a cost-appropriate Codex model and reasoning level for a requested task, briefly explains the routing choice, and then delegates the original request for completion. It is intended for users who want a simple balance between capability, reasoning effort, and likely execution cost.
capabilities: Delegate and complete the original task
defaultPrompt: Choose an efficient execution profile and complete my task.
Route this task to an appropriate model and reasoning level.
